body_markdown:
It’s estimated that there are about 100 million books in the world, but because of time and resource constraints, only about 1 million of them are also available as audiobooks. At Spotify, we want to help more stories reach listeners in more languages.


In September,


[we launched Audiobook Creation Tools in the U.S](https://authors.spotify.com/audiobook-creation-tools) . The tools give eligible self-published authors a new way to turn their finished manuscript into an audiobook. Starting today, they’re available to self-published authors in 21 more markets: the U.K., Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Guatemala, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Honduras, Paraguay, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, and Uruguay. Authors can also now turn Spanish-language manuscripts into Spanish-language audiobooks.


“Since we launched in the U.S., we’ve watched self-published authors turn manuscripts into audiobooks people actually come back to,” said


**Chester Lau** , Author Growth at Spotify.“Bringing these tools to 21 more markets means many more stories can find listeners. And we’re particularly excited about Spanish-language support for more local-language audio creation, something we know there is untapped demand for.”


## **How it works**


Audiobook Creation Tools are built into Spotify for Authors. An author uploads a finished manuscript as an .epub file and picks a voice from a curated library of licensed digital voices. That library now includes new Spanish voices from


[ElevenLabs](https://elevenlabs.io/) . Before publishing, authors can listen back to preview every chapter and make adjustments to things like pronunciation. And nothing goes live until the author approves it.


Each eligible author can create up to five audiobooks through the program at no cost, and titles made with the tools can be published in


[180 markets](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-10-07/audiobooks-global-expansion/) . Authors need a validated payment profile on file to get access to the free tools.


“We built Audiobook Creation Tools with a simple belief: every story deserves to be listened to, not just read,” Chester said. Whether you’re an emerging author for whom the cost of audio creation has made the audiobook format inaccessible, or somebody who has a backlist waiting to be heard, you now have the opportunity to take your stories further.”


## **A new path for authors**


Professional narration is a craft, and an essential part of the audiobook ecosystem. These tools are designed to give emerging authors a pathway to audio, as well as provide support to those with backlist titles that might not otherwise be made into audiobooks.


Since the U.S. launch, Spotify for Authors sign-ups have more than doubled, and nearly two in three new authors have tried Audiobook Creation Tools. More than 60% of uploaded manuscripts have gone on to be published, and listeners are coming back to these titles at the same rate as other self-published audiobooks on Spotify.


We’ll keep listening to authors, narrators, and listeners and improve the tools based on their feedback.


*Eligible authors can get started today at*[Spotify for Authors](https://authors.spotify.com/) *.*
